local View = {}

local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder

	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100
	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder

	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end

	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), width or 0.14, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a = index * math.pi / 6
			local b = (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(x + math.cos(a) * radius, y + math.sin(a) * radius, x + math.cos(b) * radius, y + math.sin(b) * radius, width or 0.12)
		end
	end

	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" or role == "plus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and 45 or 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and -45 or 90, 0.5)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33, 0.26, 0.16, math.deg(angle), 0.3)
		end
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end

	return holder
end

local palette = {
	bg0 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 17, 36),
	bg1 = Color3.fromRGB(11, 23, 48),
	bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 46, 86),
	navy = Color3.fromRGB(10, 34, 71),
	cyan = Color3.fromRGB(51, 207, 255),
	cobalt = Color3.fromRGB(45, 91, 255),
	gold = Color3.fromRGB(231, 185, 74),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),
	textSoft = Color3.fromRGB(187, 213, 242),
	success = Color3.fromRGB(73, 217, 139),
	off = Color3.fromRGB(73, 98, 133),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(7, 17, 31),
}

local fontDisplay = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local fontHeading = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local fontButton = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local fontBody = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local fontCaption = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local fontNumeric = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)

local function addNativeShadow(parent)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and shadow then
		shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shadow.Transparency = 0.72
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6)
		shadow.Parent = parent
		return shadow
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeTextLabel(parent, name, text, size, face, color, alignX)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.FontFace = face
	label.TextXAlignment = alignX or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Parent = parent

	local constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	constraint.MinTextSize = math.max(12, size - 8)
	constraint.MaxTextSize = size
	constraint.Parent = label

	return label
end

local function makeBackground(root)
	local backgroundRoot = Instance.new("Frame")
	backgroundRoot.Name = "BackgroundRoot"
	backgroundRoot.BackgroundColor3 = palette.bg0
	backgroundRoot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	backgroundRoot.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	backgroundRoot.Parent = root

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.bg1),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, palette.bg0),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.bg2),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local bloomTop = Instance.new("Frame")
	bloomTop.Name = "BloomTop"
	bloomTop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	bloomTop.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.08)
	bloomTop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.42)
	bloomTop.BackgroundColor3 = palette.cobalt
	bloomTop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	bloomTop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bloomTop.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local topCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	topCorner.Parent = bloomTop

	local bloomTopGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	bloomTopGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.cobalt),
	})
	bloomTopGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5),
	})
	bloomTopGrad.Rotation = 0
	bloomTopGrad.Parent = bloomTop

	local bloomCenter = Instance.new("Frame")
	bloomCenter.Name = "BloomCenter"
	bloomCenter.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bloomCenter.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	bloomCenter.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.38)
	bloomCenter.BackgroundColor3 = palette.cyan
	bloomCenter.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
	bloomCenter.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bloomCenter.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local centerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	centerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	centerCorner.Parent = bloomCenter

	local centerGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	centerGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.cobalt),
	})
	centerGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.12),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.7),
	})
	centerGrad.Parent = bloomCenter

	local vignette = Instance.new("Frame")
	vignette.Name = "Vignette"
	vignette.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vignette.BorderSizePixel = 0
	vignette.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	vignette.Parent = backgroundRoot

	for _, spec in ipairs({
		{ "TopEdge", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) },
		{ "BottomEdge", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 140), UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -140) },
		{ "LeftEdge", UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) },
		{ "RightEdge", UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0), UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 0) },
	}) do
		local edge = Instance.new("Frame")
		edge.Name = spec[1]
		edge.Size = spec[2]
		edge.Position = spec[3]
		edge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = palette.shadow
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
		edge.Parent = vignette
	end

	local cornerOrnaments = Instance.new("Frame")
	cornerOrnaments.Name = "CornerOrnaments"
	cornerOrnaments.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cornerOrnaments.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cornerOrnaments.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	cornerOrnaments.Parent = backgroundRoot

	for _, spec in ipairs({
		{ "TopLeft", 0, 0, 0 },
		{ "TopRight", 1, 0, 90 },
		{ "BottomRight", 1, 1, 180 },
		{ "BottomLeft", 0, 1, 270 },
	}) do
		local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = spec[1]
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
		holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(spec[2], spec[3])
		holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(spec[2], spec[3])
		holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(132, 132)
		holder.Parent = cornerOrnaments

		local a = Instance.new("Frame")
		a.Name = "ArmA"
		a.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
		a.BorderSizePixel = 0
		a.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		a.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.24)
		a.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 12)
		a.Rotation = spec[4]
		a.Parent = holder
		local ac = Instance.new("UICorner")
		ac.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		ac.Parent = a

		local b = Instance.new("Frame")
		b.Name = "ArmB"
		b.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.32)
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 70)
		b.Rotation = spec[4]
		b.Parent = holder
		local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
		bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		bc.Parent = b

		local gold = Instance.new("Frame")
		gold.Name = "GoldTip"
		gold.BackgroundColor3 = palette.gold
		gold.BorderSizePixel = 0
		gold.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		gold.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.41, 0.41)
		gold.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
		gold.Rotation = 45 + spec[4]
		gold.Parent = holder
	end

	return backgroundRoot
end

local function makeTitlePlate(parent, mobile)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "TitlePlate"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	holder.Position = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.07) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.09)
	holder.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.14) or UDim2.fromScale(0.54, 0.16)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local shadowHost = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadowHost.Name = "ShadowHost"
	shadowHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shadowHost.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadowHost.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadowHost.Parent = holder
	addNativeShadow(shadowHost)

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = "Visual"
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	plate.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	plate.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.Parent = holder

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, mobile and 18 or 22)
	corner.Parent = plate

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = palette.navy
	stroke.Thickness = mobile and 4 or 5
	stroke.Transparency = 0
	stroke.Parent = plate

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.cobalt),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = plate

	local topGloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	topGloss.Name = "Gloss"
	topGloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	topGloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.76
	topGloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	topGloss.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.38, 0)
	topGloss.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
	topGloss.Parent = plate
	local topGlossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	topGlossCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, mobile and 14 or 16)
	topGlossCorner.Parent = topGloss

	local trim = Instance.new("Frame")
	trim.Name = "GoldTrim"
	trim.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	trim.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
	trim.Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 5)
	trim.BackgroundColor3 = palette.gold
	trim.BorderSizePixel = 0
	trim.Parent = plate
	local trimCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trimCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trimCorner.Parent = trim

	local leftCap = Instance.new("Frame")
	leftCap.Name = "LeftCap"
	leftCap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	leftCap.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	leftCap.Size = UDim2.new(0, mobile and 42 or 56, 0.72, 0)
	leftCap.BackgroundColor3 = palette.navy
	leftCap.BorderSizePixel = 0
	leftCap.Parent = plate

	local rightCap = leftCap:Clone()
	rightCap.Name = "RightCap"
	rightCap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	rightCap.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5)
	rightCap.Parent = plate

	local title = makeTextLabel(holder, "AuroraTitle", "AURORA", mobile and 34 or 44, fontDisplay, palette.text)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -8)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 2)
	title.ZIndex = 2

	local titleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	titleStroke.Color = palette.navy
	titleStroke.Transparency = 0.56
	titleStroke.Thickness = 1.2
	titleStroke.Parent = title

	return holder
end

local function makeImageButton(parent, name, imageUri, slice, sliceScale, size)
	local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Image = imageUri
	button.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	button.SliceCenter = Rect.new(slice[1], slice[2], slice[3], slice[4])
	button.SliceScale = sliceScale
	button.Size = size
	button.Parent = parent
	return button
end

local function makeButtonContents(button, labelText, iconRole, iconImageUri, mobile, isLarge)
	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.Parent = button

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, -14)
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 7)
	content.Parent = visual

	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
	list.Parent = content

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.Parent = content

	local iconHolder
	if iconImageUri then
		iconHolder = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		iconHolder.Name = button.Name .. "Icon"
		iconHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		iconHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mobile and 28 or 30, mobile and 28 or 30)
		iconHolder.Image = iconImageUri
		iconHolder.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		iconHolder.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		iconHolder.Parent = content
	else
		iconHolder = createNexusIcon(content, iconRole, {
			name = button.Name .. "Icon",
			size = mobile and 28 or 30,
			padding = 12,
			color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		})
	end

	local text = makeTextLabel(content, "Label", labelText, isLarge and (mobile and 20 or 24) or (mobile and 20 or 22), fontButton, palette.text)
	text.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 32)
	text.TextWrapped = false

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Color = palette.navy
	textStroke.Transparency = 0.62
	textStroke.Thickness = 1
	textStroke.Parent = text

	return visual
end

local function makeNativeCloseButton(parent, mobile)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = "SettingsCloseButton"
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 83, 138)
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Text = ""
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52) or UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46)
	button.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
	corner.Parent = button

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = palette.navy
	stroke.Thickness = 4
	stroke.Parent = button

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.cobalt),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = button

	local trim = Instance.new("Frame")
	trim.Name = "GoldTrim"
	trim.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	trim.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
	trim.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 4)
	trim.BackgroundColor3 = palette.gold
	trim.BorderSizePixel = 0
	trim.Parent = button
	local trimCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trimCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trimCorner.Parent = trim

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.Parent = button

	createNexusIcon(visual, "close", {
		name = "SettingsCloseButtonIcon",
		size = mobile and 24 or 22,
		padding = 10,
		color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	}).AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	visual.SettingsCloseButtonIcon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	return button
end

local function makeMenuButton(parent, nodeName, labelText, imageUri, slice, mobile, iconRole, iconImageUri, heightScale, large)
	local sizeY = large and (mobile and 0.16 or 0.19) or (mobile and 0.13 or 0.125)
	local button = makeImageButton(parent, nodeName, imageUri, slice, 0.2, UDim2.new(1, 0, sizeY * heightScale, 0))
	button.LayoutOrder = large and 1 or (nodeName == "SettingsButton" and 2 or 3)
	addNativeShadow(button)
	makeButtonContents(button, labelText, iconRole, iconImageUri, mobile, large)
	return button
end

local function makeRow(parent, name)

	row.Name = name

	row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0

	row.Parent = parent

	corner.Parent = row

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

	inner.Parent = row

	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 18)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.Parent = row

	return row

local function makeToggle(parent, mobile)
	local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	toggle.Name = "MusicToggle"
	toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toggle.Text = ""
	toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
	toggle.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(116, 52) or UDim2.fromOffset(106, 48)
	toggle.Parent = parent

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.Parent = toggle

	local ToggleOff = Instance.new("Frame")
	ToggleOff.Name = "ToggleOff"
	ToggleOff.BackgroundColor3 = palette.off
	ToggleOff.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ToggleOff.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ToggleOff.Parent = visual
	local offCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	offCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	offCorner.Parent = ToggleOff
	local offStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	offStroke.Color = palette.navy
	offStroke.Thickness = 4
	offStroke.Parent = ToggleOff

	local offGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	offGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 107, 143)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(49, 73, 106)),
	})
	offGrad.Rotation = 90
	offGrad.Parent = ToggleOff

	local ToggleOn = Instance.new("Frame")
	ToggleOn.Name = "ToggleOn"
	ToggleOn.BackgroundColor3 = palette.success
	ToggleOn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ToggleOn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ToggleOn.Visible = false
	ToggleOn.Parent = visual
	local onCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	onCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	onCorner.Parent = ToggleOn
	local onStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	onStroke.Color = palette.navy
	onStroke.Thickness = 4
	onStroke.Parent = ToggleOn
	local onGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	onGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.cyan),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(104, 236, 255)),

local function playTween(instance, info, goal)
	local existing = tweens[instance]
	if existing then
		existing:Cancel()
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
	tweens[instance] = tween
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

local function animateModal(host, show)
	local shell = host:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
	if not shell then
		host.Visible = show
		return
	end

	local targetScale = shell:FindFirstChild("OpenScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
	targetScale.Name = "OpenScale"
	targetScale.Parent = shell

	if show then
		host.Visible = true
		targetScale.Scale = 0.97
		shell.GroupTransparency = shell:IsA("CanvasGroup") and 1 or nil
		playTween(targetScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 })
		for _, gui in ipairs(shell:GetDescendants()) do
			if gui:IsA("GuiObject") then
				gui.Visible = true
			end
		end
	else
		local tween = playTween(targetScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.98 })
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if targetScale.Parent then
				targetScale.Scale = 1
			end
			if host.Parent then
				host.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function bindSlider(slider)
	local valueObject = slider:FindFirstChild("Value")
	local trackButton = slider:FindFirstChild("TrackButton")
	local valueLabel = slider:FindFirstChild("ValueLabel")

	if not valueObject or not trackButton or not valueLabel then
		return
	end

	local visual = trackButton:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local track = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("SliderTrack")
	local clip = track and track:FindFirstChild("FillClip")
	local handle = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("SliderHandle")
	if not (track and clip and handle) then
		return
	end

	local dragging = false

	local function applyValue(v)
		v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
		valueObject.Value = v
		clip.Size = UDim2.new(v, 0, 1, 0)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(v, 0, 0.5, 0)
		valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
	end

	local function setFromX(screenX)
		local absPos = trackButton.AbsolutePosition.X
		local absSize = trackButton.AbsoluteSize.X
		if absSize <= 0 then
			return
		end
		applyValue((screenX - absPos) / absSize)
	end

	trackButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		setFromX(pos.X)
	end)

	trackButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
			playTween(handle, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(handle.AbsoluteSize.X > 32 and 32 or 28, handle.AbsoluteSize.Y > 32 and 32 or 28) })
		end
	end)

	trackButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	trackButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
			local isMobile = handle.AbsoluteSize.X > 32
			playTween(handle, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = isMobile and UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34) or UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30) })
		end
	end)

	applyValue(valueObject.Value)
end

local function bindToggle(toggle)
	local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local onState = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleOn")
	local offState = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleOff")
	local thumb = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleThumb")
	local stateLabel = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("StateLabel")
	if not (onState and offState and thumb and stateLabel) then
		return
	end

	local isOn = true
	local onX = 1 - (thumb.Size.X.Offset + 4) / math.max(1, toggle.AbsoluteSize.X)

	local function refresh(animated)
		onState.Visible = isOn
		offState.Visible = not isOn
		stateLabel.Text = isOn and "ON" or "OFF"
		local goal = isOn and UDim2.new(onX, 0, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
		if animated then
			playTween(thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = goal })
		else
			thumb.Position = goal
		end
	end

	toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
		isOn = not isOn
		refresh(true)
	end)

	refresh(false)
end

	local creditsHost = group:FindFirstChild("CreditsModalHost", true)
	local overlay = group:FindFirstChild("ModalOverlay", true)
	local dismiss = overlay and overlay:FindFirstChild("Dismiss")
	local hook = group:FindFirstChild("OnPlayRequestedHook", true)

	local function hideAll()
		activeModalByRoot[group] = nil
		if overlay then
			overlay.Visible = false
		end
		if dismiss then
			dismiss.Visible = false
		end
		if settingsHost and settingsHost.Visible then
			animateModal(settingsHost, false)
		end
		if creditsHost and creditsHost.Visible then
			animateModal(creditsHost, false)
		end
	end

	local function showModal(which)
		activeModalByRoot[group] = which
		if overlay then
			overlay.Visible = true
		end
		if dismiss then
			dismiss.Visible = true
		end
		if which == "Settings" then
			if creditsHost then
				creditsHost.Visible = false
			end
			if settingsHost then
				animateModal(settingsHost, true)
			end
		elseif which == "Credits" then
			if settingsHost then
				settingsHost.Visible = false
			end
			if creditsHost then
				animateModal(creditsHost, true)
			end
		end
	end

	if playButton then
		table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(playButton, {
			visual = playButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or playButton,
			hoverScale = 1.035,
			pressScale = 0.965,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		playButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			hideAll()
			root.Enabled = false
			root:SetAttribute("PlayRequested", true)
			if hook and hook:IsA("BindableEvent") then
				hook:Fire()
			end
		end)
	end

	if settingsButton then
		table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(settingsButton, {
			visual = settingsButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or settingsButton,
			hoverScale = 1.025,
			pressScale = 0.972,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		settingsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if activeModalByRoot[group] == "Settings" then
				hideAll()
			else
				showModal("Settings")
			end
		end)
	end

	if creditsButton then
		table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(creditsButton, {
			visual = creditsButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or creditsButton,
			hoverScale = 1.025,
			pressScale = 0.972,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		creditsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if activeModalByRoot[group] == "Credits" then
				hideAll()
			else
				showModal("Credits")
			end
		end)
	end

	if dismiss then
		dismiss.Activated:Connect(hideAll)
	end

	if settingsHost then
		local closeButton = settingsHost:FindFirstChild("SettingsCloseButton", true)
		if closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
			table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(closeButton, {
				visual = closeButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or closeButton,
				hoverScale = 1.02,
				pressScale = 0.96,
				duration = 0.1,
				sounds = false,
			}))
			closeButton.Activated:Connect(hideAll)
		end

		local toggle = settingsHost:FindFirstChild("MusicToggle", true)
		if toggle then
			bindToggle(toggle)
			table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(toggle, {
				visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual") or toggle,
				hoverScale = 1.015,
				pressScale = 0.98,
				duration = 0.1,
				sounds = false,
			}))
		end

		local slider = settingsHost:FindFirstChild("VolumeSlider", true)
		if slider then
			bindSlider(slider)
		end
	end

	if creditsHost then
		local closeButton = creditsHost:FindFirstChild("CreditsCloseButton", true)
		if closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
			table.insert(cleaners, ButtonEffects.bind(closeButton, {
				visual = closeButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or closeButton,
				hoverScale = 1.02,
				pressScale = 0.96,
				duration = 0.1,
				sounds = false,
			}))
			closeButton.Activated:Connect(hideAll)
		end
	end
end

for _, groupName in ipairs({ "_NexusDesktop", "_NexusMobile" }) do
	for _, group in ipairs(getBranch(groupName)) do
		setupGroup(group)
	end
end

root.Destroying:Connect(function()
	for _, cleaner in ipairs(cleaners) do
		if cleaner and cleaner.Destroy then
			cleaner:Destroy()
		end
	end
end)

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
